newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine's Kuchma reappoints foreign trade minister.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's Kuchma reappoints foreign trade minister.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma, reshuffling his government after naming a new prime minister earlier this month, on Wednesday re-appointed Serhiy Osyka as minister of foreign economic relations and trade.
A presidential spokesman said Valery Kalchenko was re-appointed as emergencies minister.
Osyka, 42, is Ukraine's chief negotiator on the former Soviet republic joining the World Trade Organisation.
Olexander Osaulenko was appointed as head of the State Statistics Committee, which replaces the statistics ministry.
Former economy minister Yuri Yekhanurov was appointed to head the newly-created committee to promote business.
